title: Optimist Deep Research: An Iterative, State-Centric Agent for Autonomous Literature Research
abstract: arXiv:2610.23299v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Most retrieval-augmented systems treat literature search as a single retrieval step followed by summarization. Real literature research works differently: the investigator's understanding of the question changes as they read, new subquestions appear, and evidence is weighed, not just collected. We present Optimist Deep Research, an open-source agent that runs literature research as an iterative evidence-acquisition process over an explicit, mutable research state. A research question is broken into a tree of subquestions, each served by search intents that are translated into source-specific queries over arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref, PubMed, Semantic Scholar and the web. Results are merged into a canonical, provenance-preserving document registry through a conservative four-tier deduplication hierarchy. translated_title: Optimist Deep Research：一种面向自主文献研究的迭代式、以状态为中心的智能体
translated_abstract: 大多数检索增强系统将文献搜索视为单一检索步骤加上后续的摘要总结。而真实的文献研究并非如此：研究者对问题的理解会随着阅读而不断变化，新的子问题会不断出现，证据需要被权衡而不是仅仅被收集。我们提出了 Optimist Deep Research，一个开源智能体，它将文献研究作为在显式、可变的研究状态之上运行的迭代式证据获取过程。研究问题被分解为子问题树，每个子问题由搜索意图提供服务，这些搜索意图被转换为针对 arXiv、OpenAlex、Crossref、PubMed、Semantic Scholar 以及网络的特定来源查询。检索结果通过保守的四层去重层级合并到一个规范的、保留来源信息的文档注册表中。该注册表通过引文滚雪球不断扩展，直到满足饱和标准，随后进行筛选、排序并分配给各子问题……
tldr: 该论文提出了开源智能体 Optimist Deep Research，将文献研究建模为在显式可变研究状态上的迭代式证据获取过程，通过子问题树分解、多源查询转换、保留来源的文档去重注册表以及引文滚雪球扩展，实现了更接近真实研究过程的自主文献研究。
en_tdlr: The paper presents Optimist Deep Research, an open-source agent that treats literature research as an iterative evidence-acquisition process over an explicit, mutable research state, combining subquestion trees, source-specific query translation, a provenance-preserving deduplication registry, and citation snowballing for autonomous literature research.
